def f(g):
    cs=components(g)
    min_t=min(min(r for r,_ in c) for _,c in cs)
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for v,c in cs:
        top=min(r for r,_ in c)
        for r,cc in sorted(c,key=lambda p:p[0] or p[0]):
            nr=r-(top-min_t)
            if 0<=nr<H: out[nr][cc]=v
    return out
